feedback.problem: The vector $v=⟨4,2⟩$ is rotated ${45}^{∘}$ counterclockwise about the origin. Find the image of $v$ under this rotation.
feedback.worked_solution:
A rotation of ${45}^{∘}$ counterclockwise about the origin is represented by the matrix 

$$
{R}_{{45}^{∘}}=[\begin{aligned}\operatorname{cos}⁡({45}^{∘}) & -\operatorname{sin}⁡({45}^{∘}) \\ \operatorname{sin}⁡({45}^{∘}) & \operatorname{cos}⁡({45}^{∘})\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} & -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} & \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\end{aligned}].
$$

To find the image ${v}^{′}$ under the action of the matrix ${R}_{{45}^{∘}}$, we compute the matrix product, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{v}^{′} & ={R}_{{45}^{∘}}\cdot v \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} & -\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} \\ \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2} & \frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}4 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\sqrt{2} \\ 3\sqrt{2}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the image is ${v}^{′}=⟨\sqrt{2},3\sqrt{2}⟩.$
